propositions: The scc command invocation in _metric_invoke omits the --by-file flag, causing scc to return empty Files arrays in language summaries instead of per-file entries.
_scc_files correctly parses per-file JSON entries but yields no results when the Files arrays are empty, preventing the threshold loop from executing and blocking all metric matches.

A present scc binary run over a repository with files above the 800-LOC threshold should emit normalized metric matches for each over-threshold file but currently emits no matches due to the missing --by-file flag.
Adding --by-file to the scc command restores per-file output and allows _scc_files to yield entries for threshold comparison, enabling the detector to emit matches as documented.
The fix is a single localized argument addition to the scc invocation with no changes to thresholds, Code field, evidence shape, or failure-open semantics.
